description: The Spokesman-Review | January 12, 2026Congressman Baumgartner holds a strong fundraising and popularity advantage in the early 2026 field. Seven challengers have entered the race for Washington's 5th Congressional District, but Baumgartner's deep roots in Eastern Washington and proven track record in his first term give him a commanding position heading into the midterm cycle.Read the full article in The Spokesman-Review
